name: Nurse
source: Following [url=https://vndb.org/c149228]Hisao[/url]'s decision to take greater care of his health, the Nurse, with the help of [url=https://vndb.org/c149234]Emi[/url], oversees his patient's cardiac rehab running schedule—a task he carries with no small amount of teasing and indiscreet questions regarding the truth of Hisao's newfound motivation.
